summary: Florida recipient records report a $20,000 GEO corporate payment to Friends of Ben Albritton on February 18, 2025, 22 days after an official immigration-enforcement proposal issued by the Florida Legislature under Senate President Albritton.
detail: The official Florida Senate page identifies Ben Albritton as Senate President. The January 27, 2025 legislature document proposed the TRUMP Act and described state/local coordination with President Trump immigration orders. The contribution, recipient identity, office, and 22-day interval are documented. No reviewed source links the payment to a request, official act, ICE procurement decision, or intervention; this is a timing/relationship crosswalk only.
